T1: Replace session authentication with JWT (including refresh token rotation) in a Django 4.2 Django REST Framework API for a mobile app while keeping the Django admin working.
T2: Debug Django users being logged out early and getting new session IDs per request after moving behind an AWS ALB with multiple instances (session storage, cookies, secret key, sticky sessions).
T3: Fix flaky Playwright e2e tests that time out waiting for a locator in GitHub Actions CI but pass locally, for a Next.js app.
T4: Fix a flaky Jest React component test using setInterval and date-fns where Jest fake timers cause the test to hang.
T5: Plan and write a runbook for a near-zero-downtime major version upgrade of a large PostgreSQL RDS database from 12 to 16 using logical replication.
T6: Safely add an index to a huge production PostgreSQL table without locking or downtime (CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY).
T7: Fix the Rust error 'future cannot be sent between threads safely' when tokio::spawn handler holds a std::sync MutexGuard across an await.
T8: Write a Terraform module for a private S3 bucket served by CloudFront with Origin Access Control and an ACM certificate in us-east-1 for a static website.
T9: Diagnose and fix a Java service being OOMKilled in Kubernetes despite -Xmx below the memory limit, by accounting for non-heap memory and tuning JVM container settings.
T10: Migrate a Python library packaging from setup.py/setup.cfg to pyproject.toml with hatchling, git-tag-based versioning, and PyPI trusted publishing from CI.
